headline: Tk 162.5m gold: 80 gold bars found in Biman workers' shoes at Dhaka airport
summary: Customs officials seized 9.34kg of gold concealed in the footwear of two airline employees on the runway.
details: Customs intelligence officials recovered 80 gold bars from the shoes of two Biman Bangladesh Airlines workers on the runway at Shahjalal International Airport.
The seized gold weighs approximately 9.34kg and is estimated to be worth Tk 162.5 million.
Acting on a tip-off, officials intercepted the workers after an Emirates flight arrived from Dubai.
The Customs Intelligence and Investigation Directorate (CIID) is now investigating the source of the gold and the intended recipients of the smuggling scheme.
caption:

Customs intelligence officials recovered 80 gold bars from the shoes of two Biman Bangladesh Airlines workers on the runway at Shahjalal International Airport.

The seized gold weighs approximately 9.34kg and is estimated to be worth Tk 162.5 million.

Acting on a tip-off, officials intercepted the workers after an Emirates flight arrived from Dubai.

The Customs Intelligence and Investigation Directorate (CIID) is now investigating the source of the gold and the intended recipients of the smuggling scheme.

headline: 7-0 victory: Argentina thrashes Burkina Faso at the Monumental
summary: The Albiceleste scored 11 goals in two matches without conceding a single goal during the FIFA international break.
details: Argentina dominated the match at the Monumental Stadium, securing a massive 7-0 win over Burkina Faso in their second friendly of the FIFA international break.
The onslaught began early with Lautaro Martínez scoring a penalty in the 4th minute, followed by an own goal in the 8th minute to make it 2-0.
The lead was extended further by Gianluca Prestianni in the 12th minute and Nicolás Paz in the 35th, with Julián Álvarez adding a fifth goal just one minute later.
After the interval, substitute Franco Mastantuono scored his first international goal in the 57th minute, continuing the dominance of Scaloni's side.
Giovanni Simeone completed the rout with a seventh goal in stoppage time (90+3'), bringing the final score to 7-0.
This victory follows a 4-0 win over Bolivia, meaning Argentina has scored 11 goals across two games without conceding any.
Lautaro Martínez now has 42 goals in 86 appearances, continuing his climb up the list of Argentina's all-time top scorers.
caption:
11 goals, 0 conceded. Argentina is in devastating form!

Argentina dominated the match at the Monumental Stadium, securing a massive 7-0 win over Burkina Faso in their second friendly of the FIFA international break.

The onslaught began early with Lautaro Martínez scoring a penalty in the 4th minute, followed by an own goal in the 8th minute to make it 2-0.

The lead was extended further by Gianluca Prestianni in the 12th minute and Nicolás Paz in the 35th, with Julián Álvarez adding a fifth goal just one minute later.

After the interval, substitute Franco Mastantuono scored his first international goal in the 57th minute, continuing the dominance of Scaloni's side.

Giovanni Simeone completed the rout with a seventh goal in stoppage time (90+3'), bringing the final score to 7-0.

This victory follows a 4-0 win over Bolivia, meaning Argentina has scored 11 goals across two games without conceding any.

Lautaro Martínez now has 42 goals in 86 appearances, continuing his climb up the list of Argentina's all-time top scorers.
